en-US.title: cert900: IT Cert Practice
en-US.subtitle: CompTIA, Cisco, AWS, Azure
en-US.promoText: 3,666 original questions across eleven certifications: CompTIA, Cisco, AWS, and Microsoft. Adaptive drills, timed exams on the real scoring, and full offline practice.
en-US.description:
cert900 is a free practice trainer for eleven IT certifications, spanning CompTIA, Cisco, AWS, and Microsoft. Practice anywhere, even offline, with every question written from the current exam objectives and linked to a free training video so you always know where to review.

ELEVEN EXAMS, ONE APP
- CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201)
- CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202)
- CompTIA Network+ (N10-009)
- CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
- Cisco CCNA (200-301)
- AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03)
- Microsoft Certified Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
- Microsoft Certified Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
- Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

WHAT YOU GET
- 3,666 original practice questions, written for the current exam versions, never copied from real exams.
- Timed full-exam mode that scores on each exam's real scale and cut line, plus short adaptive drills for daily practice.
- 138 performance-based and interactive questions in each vendor's own format: CompTIA and Cisco simulations, and AWS and Azure ordering, matching, and build-list items.
- A review queue with spaced repetition that brings back exactly the questions you got wrong.
- A readiness estimate and per-domain accuracy so you can see where you stand.
- A free training video link on every question: Professor Messer for CompTIA, Jeremy's IT Lab for CCNA, and curated video for AWS and Azure.
- Everything works offline. Your progress is saved on the device.
- Optional sign-in to sync progress across devices and with cert900.com. Sign-in is never required.
- No signup wall and no paywall. The full question bank is free.

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone studying for a CompTIA, Cisco, AWS, or Microsoft certification who wants honest, no-cost practice that mirrors the real scoring and points straight to trusted video explanations.

cert900 is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by CompTIA, Cisco Systems, Amazon Web Services, or Microsoft. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

review.notes: This app has no user accounts and requires no credentials to review. Every question, drill, timed exam, and progress view is fully available without signing in, so the reviewer does not need a login. Sign in with Google or Apple is an optional convenience that mirrors on-device progress to the user's other devices; it is not used to set up or authenticate a primary account, and no feature is gated behind it. Account deletion is available in-app on the Account screen, opened from the header on the exams list, via Delete account. Every question links to a public, free training video. All practice content is original and written from the published exam objectives; it is not copied from real exams. cert900 is independent and not affiliated with CompTIA, AWS, or Microsoft.
